company.name: Schub
company.tagline: We Boost Ideas and Founders to Create Impactful Ventures
company.description:
Our name 'Schub' translates to 'Booster' in German, reflecting our mission: to help companies get off the ground and accelerate successfully.

Schub is about ambition, action, acceleration, excellence, collegiality, community, will to succeed, positivity and shooting for the stars. 

We love sharing our insights and believe in a very strong European innovator ecosystem that we want to foster with every action we take.

We have 4 core offerings; Space, Labs, Transform and Seed, the 4 units that make up our internal Schub ecosystem.

In Schub Space we bring together ambitious talent to develop early-stage ideas into committed ventures. In Labs, we partner with entrepreneurs and help them grow their company. In Transform, we transform established company’s core processes to AI first and in Seed, we provide capital and advise to early stage startups.
